page_title: CHE 2-1 CRY | Chelsea v Crystal Palace 27/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Michael Salisbury is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+9' Chelsea take a short corner kick.
90+8' Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
90+8' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
90+5' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+2' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a change. Alfie Gilchrist (Chelsea) replaces Benoit Badiashile.
90' Substitution. Jefferson Lerma will be replaced by Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace).
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
89' 2 - 1 Goal! Noni Madueke (Chelsea) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Dean Henderson into the bottom left corner.
89' It’s a PENALTY to Chelsea after the VAR review!
89' Referee Michael Salisbury makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Chelsea. Let’s see what happens!
88' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
86' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

84' Armando Broja (Chelsea) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post.
83' Crystal Palace failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

82' A snap shot by Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Djordje Petrovic produces a good save to thwart him. Crystal Palace win a corner.
80' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) was quite harsh and Michael Salisbury didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
80' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jeffrey Schlupp (Crystal Palace) for Jordan Ayew.
79' Celebrations are cut short for Chelsea as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
79' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Chelsea players aren’t happy.
77' Amazing piece of skill! Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) picks up a cross on the edge of the 18-yard box and hammers the ball precisely into the bottom left corner. What a finish!
76' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post.
74' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
74' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
71' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Armando Broja.
71' The substitution has been made. Noni Madueke (Chelsea) has replaced Christopher Nkunku.
68' Jordan Ayew (Crystal Palace) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
67' Romeo Lavia (Chelsea) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Michael Salisbury blows for a foul.
67' Great teamplay by Chelsea as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
64' The game is interrupted as Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is flagged offside.
58' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Romeo Lavia (Chelsea) replacing Ian Maatsen.
58' Thiago Silva (Chelsea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Levi Colwill.
58' Crystal Palace take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' The resulting set piece from Crystal Palace is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. It will be a corner kick for Crystal Palace.

57' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) gets inside the box and tries to beat Djordje Petrovic with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. Crystal Palace have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
54' The free kick from long distance is taken by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace), who fires in a direct effort just wide of the left post. What a chance!
54' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
52' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Salisbury had an easy-decision to make.
52' Good defending. Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) tries to find Jean-Philippe Mateta inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
50' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
48' The game is interrupted now, Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
48' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' 1 - 1 Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and with a precise low drive puts the ball into the bottom right corner.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
43' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
42' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) makes a rough challenge and Michael Salisbury blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Chelsea.
41' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) sends a long cross over to Mykhailo Mudryk, but Dean Henderson comes forward to gather the ball.
39' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
37' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) takes the corner which is cleared.
36' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball is out of play and Chelsea manage to earn a corner.
34' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

33' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Mykhailo Mudryk was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat. Now Chelsea have a corner.
33' The free kick from long range, taken by Crystal Palace, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
32' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
30' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
30' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) sprays a pass out to Christopher Nkunku, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
28' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
28' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
26' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
23' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range low towards the middle of the net, but Dean Henderson was alert and made an amazing save!
22' Chelsea hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
20' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

18' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well over the crossbar.
18' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
17' Michael Salisbury blows the whistle, Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) is penalised for a foul. Chelsea have a free kick.
13' 1 - 0 Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
11' Ian Maatsen (Chelsea) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
9' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Djordje Petrovic and he's equal to it.
7' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but the effort goes just wide of the right post.

6' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Crystal Palace will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
3' A cross is whipped into the box by Nathaniel Clyne (Crystal Palace) and Jean-Philippe Mateta controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Crystal Palace will have the kick-off.
Michael Salisbury is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
